step: R2(a,b) -- human agreement of 600-char automatic labels; legacy 700-char human window

meta.git_worktree_note: working tree has uncommitted edits to other files; pipeline modules used here were imported unmodified and patched in memory only

what_humans_saw.claim_scope: Agreement with LEGACY 700-character human labels. No human judged the exact 600-character generator input; these numbers do not validate relation support on the exact model input.

labels.nli600: DeBERTa-v3-large NLI, premise text[:600], undated hypothesis. Task B: the e0 MPS labels (nli_support_labels_600.jsonl); masked pack: r1_nli_masked_600.jsonl (CUDA). CUDA and MPS agree on 4,390/4,390 unmasked labels (r1_masked_nli.json).
labels.nli600_dated: same, hypothesis 'As of <question date>, the answer to ... is ...' (r2_dated_nli.py)
labels.legacy_string_700_as_shown_to_humans: gold_in_text on the exact human excerpt window (reference)

a_passage_level.weighting: unweighted passage rows (Task B 900 rows incl. 138 repeated passages; masked pack 630)
a_passage_level.exclusion_is_lower_bound: only rows where the GOLD STRING is visible to humans but not to the generator are excluded; other semantic content in chars 600-700 can also change a human judgement and is not detectable this way

b_question_level.restricted_subset_statement: Humans labelled 3 passages per question; generators saw 5. '*_shown3' labels are computed on exactly the 3 human-labelled doc ids and form a RESTRICTED ANNOTATION SUBSET. '*_5passages' labels are the analysis labels; comparing them with a 3-passage human label mixes coverage.

task_b.human_label: any labelled passage YES (strict) / YES or PARTIAL; majority of 3, adjudicated
task_b.weighting_note: design_weighted_items_population_estimate uses the pack's item design (300 items, weight_to_population); hsi_convention_question_weighted gives each distinct question its cell's item weight once, as human_support_interaction.py does
